lines.zh: 我腿短，走起来一颠一颠。
lines.en: Short legs. I bounce as I walk.

lines.zh: 我跟在你脚边，不敢走远。
lines.en: At your heel. Don't dare stray.
Wings not grown in. Still soft.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚跟，退开了。
lines.en: I stepped on your heel. Backing off.
I trot to keep up.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴太长，会绊到自己。
lines.en: My tail's too long. I trip on it.

lines.zh: 我走两步抬头看你一次。
lines.en: Two steps, one look up.
The silver is still pale.

lines.zh: 我爬到石头上，又跳下来。
lines.en: I climb a stone and hop down.
I trot along, wings flapping.

lines.zh: 我绕到你前面，又退回来。
lines.en: I run ahead, then come back.

lines.zh: 我这些小爪子，抓不住硬地。
lines.en: Claws this small. Hard ground slips.

lines.zh: 我的步子稀碎，跟不上你。
lines.en: Short clumsy steps. Can't keep pace.
Slow down. My legs are short.
My scales are soft. Don't squeeze.
I look up. Waiting to be patted.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一点火星。
lines.en: A spark in my throat.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，牙还很小。
lines.en: I yawn. My teeth are tiny.
I coil up. Warm.
You sit. I lie down.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，还飞不起来。
lines.en: I flap. Can't fly yet.
I tuck my head into my tail.

lines.zh: 这地方太大了，我有点怕。
lines.en: This place is so big. A little scary.
I reach a claw for your hand.
Counting your breaths.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片还没硬，摸着像布。
lines.en: Scales still soft. Like cloth.
You move and I'm awake.
I lie on your boot.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子仰得很酸。
lines.en: I look up. My neck aches.
You're so tall. I'm so small.
Where to? Take me.
I look at you because I want to be held.
I blink. Afraid you'll leave.
You crouch and I run over.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，是我的吗。
lines.en: Is that meat in your hand for me?
You smile and my tail wags.

lines.zh: 我还不认识别人，只认识你。
lines.en: I know no one else. Only you.

lines.zh: 我站起来，前爪搭你腿上。
lines.en: I stand. Foreclaws on your leg.
Call my name and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里，这里安全。
lines.en: In your shadow. Safe here.

lines.zh: 我抬头的时候，嘴是张着的。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open when I look up.
Your face is so far away.
A small sound from me.
Scratch my chin.
That stings. Backing off a bit.
A tiny scale came off.
I curl up and hide.

lines.zh: 银色的幼龙，声音还很细。
lines.en: A silver hatchling's voice is still thin.
A pale mark shows on my scales.
Where are you? I'm scared.
I crawl to your feet.
This will heal fast.
Don't look. I know it's bad.

lines.zh: 我呜了一声，往你身后躲。
lines.en: I whimper and hide behind you.
Food! I'm hungry right now.
Just a small piece.
Crouch a little; my legs are short.
I'll mouth it, not swallow.
Anything else after this?
I make a mess eating.
I chew slowly. Small teeth.
I lick it, then pull back.
After I eat, I'll rub against your leg.
Crouch down and feed me.
I hug your heels and stumble.
I hit a step and tumble down two.
I'm tiny. Look down.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过你的膝盖。
lines.en: My wing brushes your knee.
One bump. Doesn't hurt.
I shake my head. My wing's crooked.
One push and I roll. Easy.

lines.zh: 我从你的披风下面钻过。
lines.en: I slip under your cloak.

lines.zh: 我躲在你靴子后面探头。
lines.en: I peek from behind your boot.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绊在你的靴子上。
lines.en: My tail snags on your boot.
I'm little. Don't understand that.
I only want to follow you.
You're everyone I know.
I lie in your palm.
Don't put me down.
I sleep pressed against you.
When I'm a bit bigger.
I nuzzle your hand. That's all.
Will you always be here?
I don't like others near you.
I carry it over to you.
Too heavy to drag.
I bite it. Teeth too small.
Show me. What is it?
I hide it by your feet.
My silver scales are still soft.
Too heavy for my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把东西拱给你。
lines.en: I nudge it toward you with my snout.
This makes a sound. Fun.
You dropped this. I got it.
Something's coming. I'm scared.

lines.zh: 银鳞还小，我躲到你腿后。
lines.en: Silver scales still small, I hide behind your leg.
I flatten down. Very quiet.
That thing is so much bigger.
A little fire in my throat.
I tried a roar. Thin and small.
With you in front, I'm brave.
I growl toward that shape.
I stand before your feet.

lines.zh: 那东西再近，我就要叫了。
lines.en: One more step and I start squealing.
I want to protect you. Even small.
I bite at its shadow.
Two steps back. Then I hold.
Something snapped a branch.
I keep calling. Thin voice.

lines.zh: 我学着成年龙的样子压低身。
lines.en: I crouch the way grown dragons do.
It backed off? I can't believe it.
I stand before you. My legs shake.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，学大的样子。
lines.en: I crouch, copying the big ones.
It fears fire too, I think.

lines.zh: 银色的我还小，先跟着你。
lines.en: Silver and young; I'll follow for now.
Hold still. I'll try.
I inch forward one block.

lines.zh: 它发出声音，我缩了一下。
lines.en: It made a sound. I flinched.
But I'm still here.
Counting how far away it is.
Any closer and I breathe fire.
My small claws dig into the ground.
Little wings spread. Now.
I flutter up and peck its feet.
Not much strength in that bite.
I spat a little flame.
It lifted a foot. I dodged.
My claws raked its hide.
I fell over too.
Did you see? I hit it.
I bite its tail and hold on.
My teeth hurt a little.
I retreat to your side.
A tail flick for courage.
That one had my whole weight in it.
Not down yet. Still biting.
You're here. So I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是你的手。
lines.en: The first thing I see is your hand.
The shell was hard. Took ages.
The first thing I saw was you.
Can't stand steady. Legs shake.
The slime on me isn't dry yet.
I crawl to your hand.

lines.zh: 我试着叫，只出来一点声。
lines.en: I try to call. Barely a sound.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成小小一团。
lines.en: I curl into a tiny ball.
I shake out my wings. Too small.
I curl up. Cold.
Your hands lifted me.
From the shell, you were blurred.
First breath. A bit sharp.
My wings cannot spread yet.
A bit of shell still clings to my back.

lines.zh: 我跌跌撞撞朝你走过去。
lines.en: I stumble toward you.
Two steps and I fall.
I am hungry; my cry is thin.
Fire doesn't scare me. I'm just small.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔懵了。
lines.en: Fell from a height. Dazed.
Water over my head. Paddling wildly.
Too loud. I rolled away.

lines.zh: 有个东西扎进我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something pierced my wing.
I don't understand it. I'm afraid.
My scales are still silver.
Thunder was so loud. I hid.
Falling. Calling for you.
